title.zh: 光合作用 · 用光开工的糖厂
title.en: Photosynthesis · A Sugar Factory Run by Light

desc.zh: 叶子用光把水和二氧化碳重排成糖和氧气：方程式逐项点开对原子账；速率随光强和二氧化碳先升后封顶，因为谁最缺谁说了算（限制因素）。
desc.en: A leaf uses light to rearrange water and carbon dioxide into sugar and oxygen: click through the equation and balance the atom ledger; then watch the rate rise with light and CO₂ — and cap out, because the scarcest input rules (the limiting factor).
